stemMd:
Each of the two instruments retains ______ original wooden case, although both now require new protective covers. The cases are displayed beside the instruments to show how they were transported.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: Each is singular and the case belongs to that individual instrument, so the possessive its is correct. The apostrophe forms are contractions rather than possessives.

distractorRationale.a: This means it is or it has, not possession.
distractorRationale.b: This means they are and cannot modify the noun phrase.
distractorRationale.d: The subject each is singular in this construction.
